# Scaling

## Summary

When running n8n at scale, with a large number of users, workflows, or executions, you need to change your n8n configuration to ensure good performance.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling.md

---

When running n8n at scale, with a large number of users, workflows, or executions, you need to change your n8n configuration to ensure good performance.

n8n can run in different [modes](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/enable-queue-mode) depending on your needs. The `queue` mode provides the best scalability. Refer to [Queue mode](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/enable-queue-mode) for configuration details.

You can configure data saving and pruning to improve database performance. Refer to [Execution data](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/manage-execution-data) for details.

## In this section

* [Measure performance](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/measure-performance): benchmark n8n's performance and resource consumption.
* [Enable queue mode](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/enable-queue-mode): run n8n across multiple worker processes for the best scalability.
* [Control concurrency](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/control-concurrency): limit how many executions run at once.
* [Manage execution data](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/manage-execution-data): configure data saving and pruning to improve database performance.
* [Handle binary data](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/handle-binary-data): handle large files without degrading n8n's performance.
* [Use external storage](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/use-external-storage): store binary data and execution data externally.
* [Fix memory issues](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/scaling/fix-memory-issues): identify and avoid memory-related errors.
